title: IndicRecipeNutri
description:
A corpus of 219,386 Indian recipes across 378 source sites, with parsed ingredients in English/Roman, a 17-class allergen surface carrying an explicit unassessed sentinel, and estimated dish-level micronutrition; a typed knowledge graph of 222,578 nodes and 6,292,393 edges across 17 node types and 21 relation types; a 67-query retrieval benchmark with knowledge-graph-derived gold sets; and two synthetic collaborative interaction logs. The food-composition layer uses the IFCT 42-nutrient schema but contains no IFCT and no Indian composition data; its values are USDA SR Legacy and UK CoFID.

Two-tier release. Structured, factual and derived fields are published under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with per-recipe source attribution. Raw recipe prose is not redistributed; a rehydration index of source URLs and SHA-256 text digests is published instead, together with a re-fetch script.

Known defects are published, not hidden. An independent allergen and diet audit ships with the data. See the datasheet before use, and do not use the allergen flags for end-user safety decisions.

notes:
Corpus build v15. Recipe prose is withheld under the two-tier release model; see docs/DATASHEET.md.

METADATA COMPLETENESS (2026-09-02). Two fields are deliberately absent rather than filled with a placeholder:
  * publication_date — unset on purpose. Zenodo defaults it to the deposition date, which is the honest value; asserting a date here for a dataset whose own DATASHEET says 'NOT release-ready' would be a claim about an event that has not happened.
  * creators[].orcid — not recorded anywhere in this repository. It is the author's to supply; an ORCID is an identifier for a specific person and must not be guessed.
